Tess (Sales): Quick ask — Novum wants a hosted POC demo next Wed. They need a short high-QPS demo + a lower sustained window. Can Infra provision an ephemeral key + temporary quota?
Omar (Infra): Numbers and windows?
Tess (Sales): Peak 480 rps for 12 minutes (demo), then 70 rps sustained for 3 hours for smoke tests. Streaming SSE from their backend, low token sizes.
Priya (Security): Require server-to-server calls from static egress IPs, key TTL <= 72h (48h preferred), scope limited to generation only, logs redacted, SOC contact.
Noah (Platform): We can do ephemeral scoped key + burst window. Streaming increases concurrent connections; we'll bump per-key conn limit.
Tess (Sales): They can provide IPs: 198.51.101.0/24. TTL 48h. SOC: secops@novum.ai. Demo window: 2028-11-07T16:00:00Z - 2028-11-07T19:00:00Z, burst 16:30-16:42Z. Ticket REDWOOD-POC-701 created.
Omar (Infra): I'll set: burst_rate=480 rps window=12m, sustained_rate=70 rps, conn_limit=160 for this key. Post key once ready.
(deploy-bot): Ephemeral key provisioned: id ephem_k9z7x, scope=generation:invoke, expires in 48h, IP allowlist applied. See REDWOOD-POC-701.
Omar (Infra): Sample curl (replace <KEY>):
```
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"rw-gpt-7b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"get recommendations"}],"stream":true}'
```
Rae (SRE): I'll attach an ad-hoc dashboard and alert to #eng-oncall if error_rate > 2% or p95 > 1.5s. I'll monitor the demo window.
Novum (customer via email): Smoke test hit ~450 rps streaming, no errors. Key works.
Tess (Sales): Thanks everyone — I’ll keep the customer updated and flag if anything changes.
Priya (Security): Confirmed minimal logs retained for 7 days and key will auto-expire.
Omar (Infra): If sustained >70 rps outside the demo we will route to a smaller model automatically and notify REDWOOD-POC-701.
